name: Ceramic Flower And Decorative Vase
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Crafted from high-quality ceramic, this elegant flower vase features a smooth glossy finish and a beautifully scalloped vase mouth for a charming floral-inspired design. The sturdy ceramic construction ensures durability while providing a premium and elegant feel, making it a perfect decorative accent for any space. The included ribbon bow adds a delicate and gift-ready touch.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    Designed with a balanced and compact silhouette, perfect for displaying fresh or dried flowers:

         - Small Size: 3.54 × 5.75 in ~ 9 × 14.6 cm. Capacity: ~ 8.8 oz 

         - Large Size: 4.33 × 7.87 in ~ 11 x 20 cm.  Capacity: ~ 16.9 oz

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using UV printing technology for vibrant, detailed, and high-resolution artwork.
    - The print is durable and resistant to peeling or fading during normal use.
    - Available in single-sided , double-sided printing and full print options for personalized customization.

 

  • Functionality Use:

     - Elegant Scalloped Design: Unique flower-shaped vase mouth creates a stylish and decorative appearance.

     - Decorative Ribbon Included: Comes with a delicate ribbon bow for an elegant finishing touch.

     - Stable Base: Designed with protective bottom pads for better stability and surface protection.

     - Versatile Decoration: Perfect for displaying flowers, pampas grass, or as a standalone decorative piece for home, office, bedroom, or living room décor.

 

  • Care Instructions: To maintain the product’s quality and printed design, we recommend gentle hand cleaning only. Avoid using abrasive materials, dishwashers, or microwaves to preserve the ceramic finish and print durability.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - This personalized ceramic flower vase makes a thoughtful and stylish gift for moms, grandmas, wives, family members, friends, coworkers, teachers, or anyone who loves elegant home décor. 
    - Perfect for Mother’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, housewarmings, Christmas, Valentine’s Day, and other special occasions.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3–5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7–15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1× Ceramic Flower And Decorative Vase

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-1.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidlines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
